raw_text:
Dattatreya S Vellal (Datta)
No 47, 4st Main, 1st Phase, Girinagar, Bangalore – 560085
+91-997-231-2693 | dsvellal@gmail.com | www.dsvellal.com | LinkedIn: dattatreyavellal

Datta has over 13 years of experience in strategy & execution, software quality & craftsmanship, people leadership & culture, technical engagement & collaboration, software design & execution. Known for technical expertise, human relation skills, problem solving, creating impact to individuals & organizations, trainings & knowledge development. Brings expertise to influence and solve complex challenges & create sustainable solutions & processes. A result-driven individual, who is proactive in driving functional and technical engagements, handling uncertainties & mitigating concerns.

=== SKILLS ===
- Software architecture, design, development
- Teaching, learning, influencing
- Communication, passion, tact
- Handling business, technical and human concerns
- Expertise in programming languages, operating systems, infrastructure & technology stacks

=== EXPERIENCE ===

Competency Specialist II – Software Excellence | Philips India Limited | 2018 – Present
Responsible for building a network of influence and become an assessor, thought leader and trusted advisor in a wide range of software excellence initiatives by the Philips Software Center of Excellence (SWCoE). Teaching cross-competency teams on software topics, interviewing techniques, agile concepts. Establishing org-wide policies on BizDevOps practices, hiring. Empowering technology and cultural transformation for the organization.
- Provided directions on policies of usage of health-suite-platform solutions & migration of proprietary legacy systems on to Philips cloud platform
- Chosen by Philips India head to work with cross-functional teams (with minimal supervision) and establish new interview policies, goals & procedure globally. Pushed the bar higher by interviewing candidates for senior roles and influencing hiring decisions
- Successfully & independently led programs of SWCoE. Strategized & built proprietary code-quality analyzer for Philips, imbibing software excellence craftsmanship elements. Adopted by many businesses for quality management of daily-software-churn of ~400 software engineers, and growing
- Reverse mentoring directors and enabling them to make right policy decisions in DevOps
- Influencing the Philips global reference architecture for DevOps by providing SME inputs
- Implementing the current SWCoE excellence programs: .craft, .tune, .grow, .connect etc.
- Responsible for software planning, design & development, review, managing verification & validation cycles, control of design & development changes, production service provisioning, issue handling, monitoring & measurement of process/product (ISO 13485, 62304). For radiology informatics, supervised a team that analyzed risks, estimation & implementation of proactive risk control measures (ISO14971), participated in architectural failure mode effective analysis

Software Development Engineer II | Amazon Development Center | 2016 – 2018
Accountable & responsible for building microservices, APIs, tools & platforms for retail and risk management systems. Disambiguating complex problems, designing use-cases for scalability, performance & usability, implementing software, deploying in production & monitoring for defects.
- Implemented microservices handling scale of more than 1K transactions per second
- Facilitated many scrum & agile product ownership workshops for over 150 participants
- Optimized software by running performance benchmarking tools and saving ~34k$ in costs
- Rolled out agile-practices & daily management policies leading to 18% yield increase
- Authored knowledge sharing docs including troubleshooting, on-call & on-boarding guides

Senior Lead – Software Development | Exeter Software India Private Limited | 2013 – 2015
Responsible for critical functional & technical engagements of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (Obamacare) implementation for the states of Hawaii & Vermont.
- Responsible for many release-scoping cutting across legal, functional, development and test teams
- Directly responsible for execution of the projects, artifacts & config management
- Managed a team of 20 engineers, responsible for performance reviews, mentoring, and career planning and year-end appraisals
- Successfully resolving many critical customer situations leading to faster adoption of releases

Software Engineer | IBM India Software Labs (ISL) Bangalore | 2007 – 2013
Worked on web services, developed multiple eclipse-based plugins for IBM products. Wrote many solutions integrating IBM products to support Natural Resources Industry scenarios.

=== CONVERSATION STARTERS ===
- 2 USPTO Patents, several publications online
- Subject matter expert & invited speaker in universities across India, with over 40 motivational & technological talks & workshops, addressing over 2500 participants across 22 different academic institutions
- Toastmasters international certified competent communicator, competent leader, and leadership advisor
- At Philips, in 2020, connected with over 2500 developers across 24 geographical locations, 43 job roles, and 72 departments and influenced strategy, culture, practices to handle business, technology and human concerns. Received multiple recognitions & awards
- Mentored leaders, subordinates, peers, interns and students in technology, learning and leadership skills
- Active member and resource person for Computer Society of India, Bangalore
- Volunteered with organizations to support teaching, promoting healthy living, distributing books and uniforms to the not so privileged

=== EDUCATION ===
- 2010-11, Annamalai University, Chidambaram, TN — Master of Science, Yoga
- 2009-10, Annamalai University, Chidambaram, TN — Postgraduate diploma, Yoga
- 2003-2007, RVCE, Bangalore, Karnataka — Bachelor of Engineering, Computer Science
- 2001-2003, NCJ, Bangalore, Karnataka — Pre-university, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology
- 2001, Vijaya High School, Bangalore, Karnataka — Karnataka state board, 10th Grade
